sources.snippet: DepthAnythingV2-Small This model uses the DepthAnythingV2-Small variant, which balances model size and inference speed while maintaining strong depth estimation accuracy. It is well suited for applications such as AR/VR, robotics, scene reconstruction, and real-time 3D perception on edge devices.
